description: End-to-end reservation, provisioning, and lifecycle management of LPWAN (LoRaWAN/NB-IoT) connectivity for IoT devices in a Telecom-as-a-Service context.

project_id.description: Identifier for a customer project or tenant workspace

reservation_id.description: Identifier for a SIM/device connectivity reservation request

order_id.description: Identifier for an accepted connectivity order derived from a reservation

device_group_id.description: Identifier for a logical group of devices sharing similar connectivity policies

device_id.description: Identifier for a single IoT device (module/eUI/cellular module ID)

sim_id.description: Identifier for a physical or embedded SIM/eSIM profile

plan_id.description: Identifier for an LPWAN connectivity plan (data, SMS, coverage, SLA)

coverage_zone_id.description: Identifier for a coverage zone or footprint definition

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: search_connectivity_plans
functions.description: Search for available LPWAN connectivity plans for a project, filtered by technology, region, and usage profile.

project_id.description: Project under which connectivity will be provisioned

regions.description: Target deployment regions expressed as ISO country codes or region tags (e.g., EU, NA).

usage_profile.description: Expected traffic and behavior of the device fleet.

uplink_ratio.description: Fraction of traffic that is uplink vs downlink.

latency_requirement_ms.description: Soft upper bound on end-to-end latency.

functions.returns: List of candidate connectivity plans with pricing, coverage score, and suitability ranking.

functions.name: check_coverage_availability
functions.description: Check LPWAN coverage availability and expected quality in requested deployment areas for a candidate plan.

plan_id.description: Connectivity plan being evaluated for coverage.

areas.description: List of deployment areas to evaluate.

label.description: Human-readable name for the area (e.g., Site A, Berlin plant).

coordinates.description: For point: [lon, lat]. For polygon: array of [lon, lat] vertices.

indoor.description: Whether devices are expected to be deployed primarily indoors.

device_antenna_class.description: Approximate antenna performance class of the IoT devices.

functions.returns: Per-area coverage assessment including signal strength percentile, expected success rate, and a synthesized coverage_zone_id when applicable.

functions.name: create_connectivity_reservation
functions.description: Create a reservation for LPWAN connectivity capacity and identifiers (SIM/eUI) for a device fleet.

coverage_zone_id.description: Coverage zone chosen based on coverage evaluation.

device_group.description: Metadata describing the fleet being reserved.

device_group_id.description: Optional reference to an existing group; if omitted, a new group may be created.

reservation_policy.description: Rules for how capacity is reserved and released.

activation_deadline.description: Deadline by which reserved SIMs/eUIs must be activated.

auto_release.description: Whether to automatically release unused reserved resources after the deadline.

over_provisioning_ratio.description: Factor above expected_device_count to reserve for growth.

functions.returns: Reservation ID, reserved capacity summary, tentative pricing, and expiration time.

functions.name: get_reservation_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and details of a connectivity reservation.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Reservation status (pending/confirmed/expired/cancelled), capacity details, associated plan and coverage metadata, and optional audit history.

functions.name: confirm_reservation_to_order
functions.description: Confirm a reservation and convert it into a binding connectivity order, optionally adjusting quantities before finalization.

adjustments.description: Optional changes applied when creating the final order.

final_device_count.description: If provided, overrides reserved device count within allowed bounds.

commitment_term_months.description: Minimum term commitment for discounted pricing.

accept_terms.description: Indicates that the caller accepts the current plan terms, SLAs, and pricing.

functions.returns: Order ID, final pricing summary, commitment details, and next steps for provisioning.

functions.name: allocate_device_identifiers
functions.description: Allocate device identifiers (SIM IDs, eUIs, DevEUIs, IMSIs) for a confirmed order and optionally bind them to logical device records.

batch_size.description: Number of identifiers to allocate in this request.

multi_profile.description: Structure for when identifier_type is 'multi', combining SIM and LoRaWAN IDs.

auto_create_devices.description: Whether to automatically create device records for allocated identifiers.

device_group_id.description: Group under which auto-created devices will be registered.

functions.returns: List of allocated identifiers (with sim_id and/or device_id), allocation batch ID, and any partial fulfillment information.

functions.name: provision_devices
functions.description: Provision devices on the LPWAN core network, configuring network profiles, security keys, and activation modes.

devices.description: Devices to be provisioned and their network settings.

async.description: If true, provisioning will be processed asynchronously and a job ID will be returned.

functions.returns: Per-device provisioning status (or job ID if async), including any generated security credentials and network-assigned identifiers.

functions.name: get_device_connectivity_status
functions.description: Get real-time or last-known connectivity status for one or more devices.

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response.

time_window.description: Filter historical events/statistics to a time window.

functions.returns: For each device: current connectivity state (active/suspended/offline), last session info, usage counters, and optional event history and location.

functions.name: modify_reservation_or_order
functions.description: Modify an existing reservation or order to adjust capacity, coverage, or plan selection before full activation.

target_type.description: Indicates whether a reservation or order is being modified.

plan_change.description: Request to migrate to a different connectivity plan.

capacity_change.description: Adjust the number of devices covered by the reservation/order.

coverage_change.description: Update the coverage zone for the reservation/order where allowed.

dry_run.description: If true, returns impact summary without applying modifications.

functions.returns: Impact analysis (price/coverage/terms) and, if not dry_run, updated reservation/order details.

functions.name: cancel_reservation_or_order
functions.description: Cancel a pending reservation or an order, handling release of capacity and rollback of unactivated resources.

refund_policy.description: Preferred refund handling strategy (actual outcome depends on contract terms).

force.description: If true, attempts forced cancellation even if some devices are already active (may incur penalties).

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, refund/credit details if applicable, and description of any resources that could not be rolled back.

functions.name: retry_provisioning_task
functions.description: Retry a failed or partially completed provisioning task, optionally for a subset of affected devices.

job_id.description: Identifier of the original asynchronous provisioning job.

device_ids.description: Devices to retry when scope is 'selected_devices'.

parameter_overrides.description: Optional overrides for failed devices (e.g., APN, keys).

dry_run.description: If true, only report which devices would be retried.

functions.returns: Retry job summary including targeted devices, planned attempts, and new job ID if executed.

functions.name: list_project_orders_and_reservations
functions.description: List all connectivity reservations and orders for a project with filtering and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of reservations and orders with high-level metadata and optional aggregate statistics.

functions.name: suspend_or_restore_devices
functions.description: Suspend or restore device connectivity at the network level (e.g., for fraud, maintenance, or overdue billing).

device_group_id.description: Optional group-level operation; mutually exclusive with device_ids.

functions.returns: Per-device result indicating new lifecycle state, any errors, and a correlation ID for audit.

functions.name: search_lpwan_reservation_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across lpwan_reservation entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching lpwan_reservation entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_lpwan_reservation_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N lpwan_reservation records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_lpwan_reservation_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many lpwan_reservation records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_lpwan_reservation_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many lpwan_reservation records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_lpwan_reservation_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of lpwan_reservation data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_lpwan_reservation_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a lpwan_reservation dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_lpwan_reservation_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more lpwan_reservation entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_lpwan_reservation_snapshot
functions.description: Restore lpwan_reservation state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_lpwan_reservation_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the lpwan_reservation workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_lpwan_reservation_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across lpwan_reservation metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_lpwan_reservation_audit_events
functions.description: Search the lpwan_reservation audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_lpwan_reservation_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers lpwan_reservation workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_lpwan_reservation_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for lpwan_reservation events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_lpwan_reservation_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for lpwan_reservation events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_lpwan_reservation_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off lpwan_reservation job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_lpwan_reservation_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled lpwan_reservation jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_lpwan_reservation_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled lpwan_reservation job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_lpwan_reservation_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a lpwan_reservation operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_lpwan_reservation_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a lpwan_reservation action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_lpwan_reservation_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a lpwan_reservation approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_lpwan_reservation_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any lpwan_reservation entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_lpwan_reservation_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a lpwan_reservation entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_lpwan_reservation_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling lpwan_reservation behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_lpwan_reservation_policies
functions.description: List lpwan_reservation policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_lpwan_reservation_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two lpwan_reservation-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_lpwan_reservation_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a lpwan_reservation entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_lpwan_reservation_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many lpwan_reservation entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
